node_definition.done_when: A new tests/test_queue_steering_binding.py shows: queue_dispatch writes steering.md from --brief into the request's final run directory and never overwrites an existing one, so an edited steering.md survives an in-place re-queue of the same node; a queued request whose steering.md is replaced before launch launches with its digest matching the replaced text; the discriminating arm leaves steering.md alone, changes the file the queued pointer's node.brief path names, and the launched digest still matches steering.md; a steering.md made invalid while queued is refused inside _launch_queued and _record_queued_failure restores the request to queued with the failure named and a retry backoff, launching no worker; a request whose authority is a plan section alone has no steering.md and launches as before. The test files importing reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_admission.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py or reckon/crew/runs.py add no failures against the base revision, measured as a delta with both logs under the run directory; ruff check and ruff format --check pass on the changed paths
